title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九 宣宗
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九 宣宗 Volume 9 Annals 9: Xuanzong

sentences.zh: 宣宗憲天崇道英明神聖欽文昌武寬仁純孝章皇帝，諱瞻基，仁宗長子也。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor, revering Heaven and honoring the Way, bright and wise, divine and sagely, revering culture and martial in achievement, broad and benevolent, pure and filial, with the posthumous style Zhang, taboo name Zhanji, was Renzong's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong—honored after death as one who revered Heaven, exalted the Way, and united brilliance, sagacity, literary and martial achievement, breadth, benevolence, purity, and filial devotion under the style Zhang—was named Zhanji and was the eldest son of Emperor Renzong.

sentences.zh: 母誠孝昭皇后。

translations.literal: His mother was the Empress of Sincere Filiality and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Xiaogongzhao, known for sincere filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 生之前夕，成祖夢太祖授以大圭曰：「傳之子孫，永世其昌。

translations.literal: On the eve of his birth Chengzu dreamed Taizu bestowed a great jade scepter, saying: "Transmit to sons and grandsons; forever flourishing."
translations.idiomatic: The night before he was born the Chengzu Emperor dreamed that the founding emperor placed a great jade tablet in his hands with the words: "Pass it to your descendants, and they shall prosper for ages."

sentences.zh: 」即彌月，成祖見之曰：「兒英氣溢面，符吾夢矣。

translations.literal: When full month was reached Chengzu saw him and said: "The child's heroic spirit overflows his face—it matches my dream."
translations.idiomatic: At the child's first-month celebration Chengzu looked on him and declared: "Heroic spirit shines from his face; he fulfills my dream."

sentences.zh: 」比長，嗜書，智識傑出。

translations.literal: When grown he loved books; wisdom and knowledge were outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: As he matured he devoured books and showed exceptional intelligence.

sentences.zh: 永樂七年，從幸北京，令觀農具及田家衣食，作《務本訓》授之。

translations.literal: In Yongle year seven he accompanied the tour to Beijing; he was made to observe farm implements and peasant clothing and food, and "Instruction on Root-Concern" was composed and given him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongle he followed the court to Beijing, was shown farming tools and how farm families lived, and was presented with the essay "On Holding to the Fundamentals."

sentences.zh: 八年，成祖征沙漠，命留守北京。

translations.literal: In year eight, when Chengzu campaigned in the desert, he was ordered to remain and guard Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, during Chengzu's desert campaign, he was left behind as regent in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月，立為皇太孫，始冠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of year nine he was established Imperial Grandson Heir and first capped.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year he was named heir apparent to the throne as imperial grandson and received his capping.

sentences.zh: 自是，巡幸征討皆從。

translations.literal: From this on tours, inspections, and campaigns he always followed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he accompanied the emperor on every tour, inspection, and expedition.

sentences.zh: 嘗命學士胡廣等即軍中為太孫講論經史。

translations.literal: Once he was ordered that Academician Hu Guang and others should, right in the army, lecture the Grand Heir on Classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: On one occasion Hu Guang and fellow academicians were told to expound the classics and histories to the heir in camp.

sentences.zh: 每語仁宗曰：「此他日太平天子也。

translations.literal: Each time he would tell Renzong: "This one hereafter will be a Son of Heaven in peaceful times."
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly told Renzong: "This boy will one day be a peaceful-age emperor."

sentences.zh: 」仁宗即位，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: When Renzong took the throne he was established Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，以南京地屢震，命往居守。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, because Nanjing's ground repeatedly shook, he was ordered to go and remain in guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, after repeated earthquakes in Nanjing, he was sent south to hold the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，仁宗不豫，璽書召還。

translations.literal: On gengchen in the fifth month Renzong fell ill; an imperial-seal letter summoned him back.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the fifth month, as Renzong lay gravely ill, a sealed summons recalled him.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，還至良鄉，受遺詔，入宮發喪。

translations.literal: On xinchou in the sixth month, returning as far as Liangxiang, he received the death-testament edict, entered the palace, and inaugurated mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the sixth month he reached Liangxiang, received the dying emperor's final commands, entered the palace, and began the mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On gengxu he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he took the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，以明年為宣德元年。

translations.literal: Great pardon under Heaven; the coming year was made Xuande year one.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the following year was declared the first year of the Xuande reign.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，諭邊將嚴守備。

translations.literal: On xinhai border generals were instructed to guard defenses strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai frontier commanders were ordered to tighten their defenses.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，趣中官在外採辦者還，罷所市物。

translations.literal: On jiayin eunuchs outside on procurement were hurried back; goods they had purchased were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin palace eunuchs sent out to buy supplies were recalled, and their purchases were canceled.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，尊皇后為皇太后，立妃胡氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on yihai the Empress was honored Empress Dowager; Consort Hu was established Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the seventh month the empress was elevated to empress dowager and Consort Hu was made empress.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮遠侯顧興祖討大藤峽蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On xinmao Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu attacked the Man of Great Vine Gorge and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu campaigned against the tribes of Great Vine Gorge and subdued them.

sentences.zh: 乙未，諭法司慎刑獄。

translations.literal: On yiwei the judiciary was instructed to be cautious with prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the legal offices were warned to handle criminal cases with care.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，安順伯薛貴、清平伯吳成、都督馬英、都指揮梁成帥師巡邊。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on wushen Anshun Earl Xue Gui, Qingping Earl Wu Cheng, Commissioner Ma Ying, and Regional Commander Liang Cheng led troops on border patrol.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the intercalary month Anshun Earl Xue Gui, Qingping Earl Wu Cheng, Commissioner Ma Ying, and Regional Commander Liang Cheng took an army to patrol the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，楊溥入直文淵閣。

translations.literal: On yichou Yang Pu entered and served directly in the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yang Pu joined the Grand Secretariat with duty in the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，都指揮李英討安定曲先叛番，大敗之，定定王桑兒加失夾詣闕謝罪。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wuchen Regional Commander Li Ying attacked the rebellious Fan of Anding Qu River and utterly defeated them; the Ding king Sang'erjiashijia came to court to beg pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the eighth month Regional Commander Li Ying crushed the rebel Tibetans of Qu River in Anding; the Ding prince Sang'erjiashijia came to court to submit.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔內外群臣舉廉潔公正堪牧民者。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict ordered inner and outer ministers to recommend those incorrupt, clean, fair, and able to shepherd the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the throne called on officials throughout the empire to nominate men of integrity and justice fit to govern the people.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大理卿胡概、參政葉春巡撫南畿、浙江。

translations.literal: On guiwei Chief Minister of Justice Hu Gai and Assistant Administrator Ye Chun toured and pacified Nanzhili and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Chief Minister Hu Gai of the Court of Judicial Review and Assistant Administrator Ye Chun were sent to inspect and settle affairs in the southern capital region and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 設巡撫自此始。

translations.literal: The touring-pacification commissioner office began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The institution of provincial grand coordinators dates from this appointment.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，葬昭皇帝于獻陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renyin the Bright Emperor was buried at Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the ninth month the late Renzong Emperor was interred at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，南京地震，戊子，敕公、侯、伯、五府、六部、大學士、給事中審覆重囚。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on wuyin Nanjing earthquaked; on wuzi princes, marquises, earls, the Five Chief Military Commissions, Six Ministries, Grand Secretaries, and supervising secretaries were ordered to review and reexamine serious prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth month Nanjing was shaken by earthquake; on wuzi dukes, marquises, earls, the five chief military commissions, the six ministries, grand secretaries, and supervising secretaries were told to rehear capital cases.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，顧興祖討平思恩蠻。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on wuxu Gu Xingzu attacked and pacified the Man of Si'en.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eleventh month Gu Xingzu put down the Si'en tribes.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，恭祿為鎮朔大將軍巡邊。

translations.literal: On xinyou Gong Lu was made Great General Pacifying the North on border patrol.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Gong Lu was appointed grand general for the northern frontier and sent to patrol the borders.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，顧興祖討平宜山蠻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on jiashen Gu Xingzu attacked and pacified the Man of Yishan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the twelfth month Gu Xingzu subdued the Yishan tribes.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密回回、滿剌撒丁、占城、琉球中山、爪哇、烏斯藏、瓦剌、浡泥入貢。

translations.literal: That year Hami Muslims, Malacca, Champa, Ryukyu Zhongshan, Java, U-Tsang, the Oirats, and Brunei presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute missions came from Hami, Malacca, Champa, Zhongshan in the Ryukyus, Java, Tibet, the Oirats, and Brunei.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，成山侯王通為征夷將軍充總兵官，討黎利，尚書陳洽參贊軍務，陳智、方政奪官從立功。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yichou Chengshan Marquis Wang Tong was made General Campaigning against the Yi, filling supreme commander, to attack Li Lei; Minister Chen Qia assisted military affairs; Chen Zhi and Fang Zheng were stripped of office to follow and earn merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the fourth month Chengshan Marquis Wang Tong was named supreme commander and general campaigning against the Yi to fight Li Lei, with Minister Chen Qia as staff officer; Chen Zhi and Fang Zheng were demoted but allowed to win back rank through service.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，錄囚。

translations.literal: On jiawu, first of the fifth month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new-moon day of the fifth month the throne held a jail delivery.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔赦交阯，許黎利自新。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict pardoned Jiaozhi and permitted Li Lei to renew himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an amnesty for Jiaozhi offered Li Lei a chance to submit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕郡縣瘞遺骸。

translations.literal: On bingwu an edict ordered prefectures and counties to bury exposed bones.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu counties were commanded to inter unburied remains.

sentences.zh: 庚申，召薛祿還。

translations.literal: On gengshen Xue Lu was summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Xue Lu was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，京師地震，乙未，免山東夏稅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on guisi the capital earthquaked; on yiwei Shandong summer grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the seventh month Beijing trembled; on yiwei summer taxes in Shandong were waived.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諭六科，凡中官傳旨，必覆奏始行。

translations.literal: On jihai the Six Offices of Scrutiny were instructed: whenever eunuchs transmitted edicts, memorial confirmation must precede execution.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the six scrutiny offices were told that no eunuch order might be carried out until it had been reported back and approved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷湖廣采木。

translations.literal: On renzi Huguang timber procurement was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the timber levy in Huguang was halted.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，漢王高煦反。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on renxu the Prince of Han Gao Xu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the eighth month the Prince of Han, Zhu Gaoxu, rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宥武臣殊死以下罪，復其官。

translations.literal: On bingyin military nobles' crimes below capital offense were pardoned and their offices restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin martial peers convicted of lesser felonies were forgiven and reinstated.

sentences.zh: 己巳，親征高煦，命鄭王瞻、襄王瞻墡居守，陽武侯薛祿、清平伯吳成將前鋒，大賚五軍將士。

translations.literal: On jisi he personally campaigned against Gao Xu; the Prince of Zheng Zhu Zhan and Prince of Xiang Zhu Zhanfan were ordered to remain in guard; Yangwu Marquis Xue Lu and Qingping Marquis Wu Cheng led the vanguard; the Five Armies troops were greatly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor marched in person against Gaoxu, leaving the princes of Zheng and Xiang as regents; Yangwu Marquis Xue Lu and Qingping Marquis Wu Cheng commanded the van, and the armies of the Five Chief Commissions received lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 辛未，發京師。

translations.literal: On xinwei he set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the imperial column left Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，至樂安，帝兩遣書諭降，又以敕系矢射城中諭禍福。

translations.literal: On xinsi he reached Le'an; the emperor twice sent letters instructing surrender, and again tied an edict to an arrow shot into the city to expound fortune and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he arrived at Le'an; twice the emperor wrote urging surrender, then had an edict bound to an arrow and shot over the walls to warn of the consequences.

sentences.zh: 壬午，高煦出降。

translations.literal: On renwu Gao Xu came out and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Gaoxu marched out and submitted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，改樂安曰武定州。

translations.literal: On guiwei Le'an was renamed Wuding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Le'an was redesignated Wuding prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，班師。

translations.literal: On yiyou the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the campaign force marched home.

sentences.zh: 九丙申。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingchen day,

sentences.zh: 」至自武定州，錮高煦於西內。

translations.literal: Returned from Wuding prefecture; Gao Xu was fettered in the western inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor returned from Wuding; Gaoxu was imprisoned in the western inner quarters.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，法司鞫高煦同謀者，詞連晉王、趙王，詔勿問。

translations.literal: On wuxu the judiciary tried Gao Xu's fellow conspirators; testimony implicated the princes of Jin and Zhao; an edict forbade inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the legal offices interrogated Gaoxu's accomplices, whose statements touched the Jin and Zhao princes; the throne ordered the matter dropped.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，釋李時勉，復為侍讀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on wuyin Li Shimian was released and restored as Reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth month Li Shimian was freed and again made a palace reader.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，成山侯王通擊黎利於應平，敗績，尚書陳洽死之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yiwei Chengshan Marquis Wang Tong fought Li Lei at Yingping and was defeated; Minister Chen Qia died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the eleventh month Wang Tong met Li Lei at Yingping, suffered defeat, and Minister Chen Qia was killed.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，免六師所過秋糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on xinyou autumn grain along the army's route was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the twelfth month autumn taxes were waived along the route the imperial forces had taken.

sentences.zh: 辛未，錄囚，宥免三千餘人。

translations.literal: On xinwei prisoners were reviewed; more than three thousand were pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a jail delivery freed over three thousand convicts.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，征南將軍總兵官黔國公沐晟帥興安伯徐亨、新甯伯譚忠，征虜副將軍安遠侯柳升帥保定伯梁銘都督崔聚，由雲南、廣西分道討黎利，兵部尚書李慶參贊軍務。

translations.literal: On yiyou the General Campaigning South, supreme commander, Qinguo Duke Mu Sheng led Xing'an Earl Xu Heng and Xinning Earl Tan Zhong; the Deputy General Campaigning against the Barbarians, Anyuan Marquis Liu Sheng, led Baoding Marquis Liang Ming and Commissioner Cui Ju—by Yunnan and Guangxi in separate columns to attack Li Lei; Minister of War Li Qing assisted military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Qinguo Duke Mu Sheng, supreme commander campaigning south, advanced through Yunnan with Xing'an Earl Xu Heng and Xinning Earl Tan Zhong, while Anyuan Marquis Liu Sheng, deputy commander against the barbarians, marched through Guangxi with Baoding Marquis Liang Ming and Commissioner Cui Ju to strike Li Lei; War Minister Li Qing served as staff officer.

sentences.zh: 是年，爪哇、暹羅、琉球、蘇門答剌、滿剌加、白葛達、撒馬兒罕、土魯番、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Java, Siam, Ryukyu, Samudera, Malacca, Barbary, Samarkand, Turfan, Hami, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Java, Siam, the Ryukyus, Samudera, Malacca, Barbary, Samarkand, Turfan, Hami, and Tibet.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on gengzi great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on gengzi in the first month, the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丁未，有司奏歲問囚數。

translations.literal: On dingwei the relevant offices reported the year's count of prisoners interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei local authorities submitted the annual figure for criminal cases heard.

sentences.zh: 帝謂百姓輕犯法，由於教化未行，命申教化。

translations.literal: The emperor said the common people lightly violated law because instruction had not been carried out; he ordered instruction emphasized.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that petty crime sprang from failed moral education and commanded officials to renew their teaching of the people.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，行在戶部待郎陳山為本部尚書兼謹身殿大學士，直文淵閣。

translations.literal: In the second month on guihai Acting Vice Minister of Revenue Chen Shan of the mobile secretariat was made full Minister of his ministry and Grand Secretary of the Jinshen Hall, serving directly in the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the second month Chen Shan, acting revenue vice minister at the southern capital, was promoted minister and grand secretary of the Jinshen Hall with a seat in the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，黎利攻交阯城，王通擊敗之。

translations.literal: On yichou Li Lei attacked the Jiaozhi city; Wang Tong defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Lei assaulted the Jiaozhi garrison and Wang Tong beat him off.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，賜馬愉等進士及第、出身秀差。

translations.literal: In the third month on xinmao palace graduates Ma Yu and others were granted jinshi with honors, and xiucai entrants were ranked.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the third month Ma Yu and other new jinshi were honored at court and lower degree holders were placed in office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，黎利陷昌江，都指揮李任，指揮顧福、劉順，知府劉子輔，中官馮智死之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on gengshen Li Lei took Changjiang; Regional Commander Li Ren, Commanders Gu Fu and Liu Shun, Prefect Liu Zifu, and Eunuch Feng Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the fourth month Li Lei overran Changjiang; Regional Commander Li Ren and Commanders Gu Fu and Liu Shun, Prefect Liu Zifu, and the eunuch Feng Zhi were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，晉王濟熿有罪，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Prince of Jin Zhu Jihuai was guilty and demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Prince Jin was found guilty and reduced to private status.

sentences.zh: 己巳，王通許黎利和。

translations.literal: On jisi Wang Tong agreed to peace with Li Lei.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wang Tong concluded a truce with Li Lei.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，薛祿督餉開平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on guisi Xue Lu supervised grain transport at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the fifth month Xue Lu took charge of supplies on the Kaiping route.

sentences.zh: 己亥，仁宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: On jihai Renzong's spirit tablet was placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Renzong's tablet was enshrined in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，錄囚。

translations.literal: On bingwu prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court held a jail delivery.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on wuyin prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the sixth month prisoners were again reviewed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，黎利陷隘留關，鎮遠侯顧興祖擁兵不救，逮治之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on jihai Li Lei took Ailiu Pass; Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu held troops and did not rescue—he was arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the seventh month Li Lei seized Ailiu Pass while Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu, who had troops nearby, failed to relieve it and was seized for trial.

sentences.zh: 庚子，錄囚。

translations.literal: On gengzi prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi another jail delivery was held.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命都督同知陳懷充總兵官，帥師討松潘蠻。

translations.literal: On xinchou Commissioner Vice Commander Chen Huai was made supreme commander, leading troops to attack the Songpan Man.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Vice Commissioner Chen Huai was appointed supreme commander to campaign against the Songpan tribes.

sentences.zh: 丁未，薛祿敗敵於開平。

translations.literal: On dingwei Xue Lu defeated the enemy at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xue Lu routed the foe near Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，黃淮致仕。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiazi Huang Huai retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month Huang Huai left office on pension.

sentences.zh: 免兩京、山西、河南州縣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Tax grain in prefectures and counties of the two capitals, Shanxi, and Henan struck by disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Grain taxes were waived in disaster-hit districts of both capitals, Shanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renchen prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the ninth month the throne again reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙未，柳升師次倒馬坡，遇伏戰死。

translations.literal: On yiwei Liu Sheng's army halted at Daoma Slope, met an ambush, and he died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Liu Sheng's column camped at Daoma Slope, walked into an ambush, and he fell fighting.

sentences.zh: 是日，保定伯梁銘病卒。

translations.literal: That day Baoding Marquis Liang Ming died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Baoding Marquis Liang Ming died of sickness.

sentences.zh: 丙申，尚書李慶病卒。

translations.literal: On bingshen Minister Li Qing died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen War Minister Li Qing also died of illness.

sentences.zh: 師大潰，參將崔聚，郎中史安，主事陳鏞、李宗昉死之。

translations.literal: The army greatly collapsed; Assistant Commander Cui Ju, Registrar Shi An, and Clerks Chen Yong, Li Zongfang died.
translations.idiomatic: The expedition broke in rout; Assistant Commander Cui Ju, Registrar Shi An, and clerks Chen Yong and Li Zongfang were killed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，王通棄交阯，與黎利盟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on wuyin Wang Tong abandoned Jiaozhi and made covenant with Li Lei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth month Wang Tong evacuated Jiaozhi and sealed a pact with Li Lei.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，赦黎利，遣侍郎李琦、羅汝敬立陳暠為安南國王，悉如文武吏士還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yiyou Li Lei was pardoned; Vice Ministers Li Qi and Luo Rujing were sent to install Chen Hao as king of Annam and to bring back all civil and military officials and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eleventh month Li Lei was amnestied; Vice Ministers Li Qi and Luo Rujing were dispatched to enthrone Chen Hao as ruler of Annam and repatriate every official and soldier.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以皇長子生大赦天下，免明年稅糧三之一。

translations.literal: On jihai, because the eldest imperial son was born, great pardon under Heaven; next year's tax grain remitted one-third.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the birth of the heir prompted a general amnesty and a third of the following year's taxes was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on dingchou Shaanxi famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the twelfth month famine relief was sent to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 並給絹布十五萬疋。

translations.literal: Silk cloth totaling one hundred fifty thousand bolts was also distributed.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk and cloth were issued as well.

sentences.zh: 是年，爪哇、占城、暹羅、琉球、瓦剌、哈密、亦力把裏、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year Java, Champa, Siam, Ryukyu, the Oirats, Hami, Yili, and Samarkand presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year missions arrived from Java, Champa, Siam, the Ryukyus, the Oirats, Hami, Yili, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on jiawu great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on jiawu in the first month, the emperor again performed the southern suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丙申，陳懷平松潘蠻。

translations.literal: On bingshen Chen Huai pacified the Songpan Man.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Chen Huai subdued the Songpan tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，立皇長子祁鎮為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second month on wuwu the eldest imperial son Qizhen was established Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the second month the eldest son Qizhen was named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是月，作《帝訓》成。

translations.literal: That month "Imperial Instruction" was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the same month the emperor finished his book "Lessons for a Ruler."

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，廢皇后胡氏，立貴妃孫氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the third month on guiwei Empress Hu was deposed; Noble Consort Sun was established Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the third month Empress Hu was removed and Noble Consort Sun was raised to empress.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，錄囚。

translations.literal: On renchen prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the court held another jail delivery.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，敕凡官民建言章疏，尚書、都御史、給事中會議以聞，勿諱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on guihai an edict: whenever officials or commoners submitted memorial proposals, Ministers, Censors-in-chief, and supervising secretaries should meet in conference and report—do not conceal.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the fourth month an edict required ministers, the censor-in-chief, and supervising secretaries to deliberate jointly on all memorials from officials and people and report without suppressing criticism.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on renyin prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the intercalary month prisoners were reviewed again.

sentences.zh: 免山西旱災稅糧。

translations.literal: Shanxi drought-disaster tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Grain taxes were waived in drought-stricken Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命有司振恤。

translations.literal: On jiachen the relevant offices were ordered to relieve and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen local authorities were commanded to distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，論棄交阯罪，王通等及布政使弋謙、中官山壽、馬騏下獄論死，籍其家，鎮遠侯顧興祖並下獄。

translations.literal: On gengxu abandoning Jiaozhi guilt was discussed; Wang Tong and others, together with Administration Commissioner Yi Qian, Eunuchs Shan Shou and Ma Qi, were imprisoned and sentenced to death, their households confiscated; Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu was also imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court judged those responsible for the loss of Jiaozhi: Wang Tong, Administration Commissioner Yi Qian, and the eunuchs Shan Shou and Ma Qi were jailed, condemned to death, and their property seized; Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu was imprisoned as well.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，李琦、羅汝敬還。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renzi, Li Qi and Luo Rujing returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, Li Qi and Luo Rujing came back from their mission.

sentences.zh: 黎利表陳暠卒，子孫並絕，乞守國俟命。

translations.literal: Le Loi memorialized that Chen Hao had died and that descendants were all extinct, begging to hold the state and await orders.
translations.idiomatic: Le Loi reported that Chen Hao was dead and the Chen line extinguished, and asked leave to govern Annam pending the throne's decision.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復遣羅汝敬等諭黎利立陳氏後。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Luo Rujing and others were again sent to instruct Le Loi to install a descendant of the Chen house.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Emperor again dispatched Luo Rujing and his party to order Le Loi to raise up a Chen heir.

sentences.zh: 辛未，贈交阯死事諸臣。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, officials who had died in Jiaozhi were posthumously honored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court ennobled the officials who had fallen in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免北京被災夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, summer tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen summer tax was forgiven in the disaster districts of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，免陝西被災夏稅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingxu, summer tax was remitted for disaster-stricken Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu, summer tax was remitted in the stricken prefectures of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，都御史劉觀巡視河道。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Censor-in-Chief Liu Guan inspected the waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Censor-in-Chief Liu Guan was sent to inspect the canal works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuchen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，罷北京行部及行後軍都督府。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinmao, the traveling ministries at Beiping and the traveling Rear Military Commission were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the traveling secretariats at Beiping and the traveling Rear Military Commission were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，帝自將巡邊。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Emperor himself led a tour of the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Emperor took the field in person to tour the border.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，次右門驛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinhai, he halted at Youmen Post.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai, he encamped at Youmen Post.

sentences.zh: 兀良哈寇會州，帝帥精卒三千人往擊之。

translations.literal: The Urianghad raided Huizhou; the Emperor led three thousand picked troops to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Urianghad bands raided Huizhou, and the Emperor rode out with three thousand elite troops to meet them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，出喜峰口，擊寇於寬河。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he went out through Xifeng Pass and attacked the raiders at Kuan River.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he marched out by Xifeng Pass and fell upon the raiders at Kuan River.

sentences.zh: 帝親射其前鋒，殪三人，兩翼軍併發，大破之。

translations.literal: The Emperor himself shot at their vanguard, killing three men; the flank armies attacked together and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor shot down three men in the van with his own bow; when the wings closed in together the enemy host was shattered.

sentences.zh: 寇望見黃龍旂，下馬羅拜請降，皆生縛之，斬渠酋。

translations.literal: Seeing the yellow dragon banner, the raiders dismounted, ranged themselves, and bowed in surrender; all were bound alive, and their chieftains were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: At sight of the imperial yellow-dragon standard the raiders dismounted and prostrated themselves; the survivors were bound and their chiefs were executed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，班師。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the army marched home.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，至自喜峰口。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, he arrived back from Xifeng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he re-entered the realm by Xifeng Pass.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，錦衣指揮鐘法保請采珠東莞，帝曰：「是欲擾民以求利也」，下之獄。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day guiyou, Brocade-Guard Commander Zhong Fabao requested to gather pearls at Dongguan; the Emperor said: "This is to trouble the people in quest of profit," and had him imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on guiyou, Brocade Guard Commander Zhong Fabao asked leave to harvest pearls at Dongguan; the Emperor said, "You mean to harass the people for gain," and cast him into prison.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，廣西總兵官山雲討擒忻城蠻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, Shan Yun, supreme commander of Guangxi, campaigned against and captured the Xincheng tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, Guangxi supreme commander Shan Yun campaigned against the Xincheng tribesmen and took them captive.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、暹羅、爪哇、琉球、瓦剌、哈密、安南、曲先、土魯番、亦力把裏、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Siam, Java, Ryukyu, Oirat, Hami, Annam, Quxian, Turfan, Yili Bali, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, Siam, Java, Ryukyu, the Oirats, Hami, Annam, Quxian, Turfan, Yili Bali, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，兩京地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, the first month: both capitals were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, at the opening of spring, the earth quaked in both capitals.

sentences.zh: 己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，南京獻騶虞二，禮部請表賀，不許。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jichou, Nanjing presented two zouyu; the Ministry of Rites requested a congratulatory memorial, but this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou, Nanjing sent up two zouyu; the Ministry of Rites asked to memorialize the omen, and the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，遣李琦再諭黎利訪立陳氏後。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiaxu, Li Qi was again sent to instruct Le Loi to seek out and install a descendant of the Chen house.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu, Li Qi was sent again to order Le Loi to find and enthrone a Chen heir.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，山雲討平柳、潯蠻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinsi, Shan Yun pacified the tribes of Liu and Xun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi, Shan Yun brought the Liu and Xun tribes to submission.

sentences.zh: 戊子，工部尚書黃福、平江伯陳瑄經略漕運。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Minister of Works Huang Fu and the Marquis of Pingjiang, Chen Xuan, were put in charge of planning the grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Minister of Works Huang Fu and Chen Xuan, Marquis of Pingjiang, were ordered to oversee the Grand Canal grain route.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renzi, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，罷文吏犯贓贖罪例。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, the regulation allowing civil officials guilty of corruption to redeem punishment was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, the statute letting corrupt civil officials buy their way out of punishment was struck down.

sentences.zh: 己亥，寇犯開平，鎮撫張信等戰死。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, raiders attacked Kaiping; Pacification Commissioner Zhang Xin and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the enemy struck Kaiping, and Pacification Commissioner Zhang Xin fell with his men.

sentences.zh: 庚子，薛祿督餉開平。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Xue Lu supervised supplies at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Xue Lu was put in charge of grain for the Kaiping garrison.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，幸文淵閣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiwei, he visited the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, he visited the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，起復楊溥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, Yang Pu was recalled from mourning to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, Yang Pu was recalled from mourning to serve again.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，釋顧興祖於獄。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guihai, Gu Xingzu was released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, Gu Xingzu was freed from prison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，幸文淵閣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengchen, he visited the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen, he again visited the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以天寒諭法司錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, because of the cold weather he charged the judiciary to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, with the season turning bitter, he ordered the judiciary to review the prisons.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，制《猗蘭操》賜廷臣，諭以薦賢為國之道。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he composed the "Melody of the Orchids in the Vale" and bestowed it on the court ministers, instructing them in the way of recommending the worthy for the sake of the state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he composed the Melody of the Orchids in the Vale and gave it to his ministers, teaching them that the state is served by raising up worthy men.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，張瑛、陳山罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Zhang Ying and Chen Shan were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhang Ying and Chen Shan were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲午，閱武於近郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, he reviewed troops near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he held a military review in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，獵於峪口。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, he hunted at Yukou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he hunted at Yukou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，薛祿及恭順侯吳克忠帥師巡宣府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guimao, Xue Lu and the Marquis of Gongshun, Wu Kezhong, led troops to patrol Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, Xue Lu and Wu Kezhong, Marquis of Gongshun, took the field to patrol Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yihai, the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai, the earth shook at the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷中官松花江造船。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the palace order to build ships on the Songhua River was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the palace order to build ships on the Songhua was revoked.

sentences.zh: 是年，爪哇、占城、琉球、榜葛刺、哈密、土魯番、亦力把裏、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Java, Champa, Ryukyu, Bengal, Hami, Turfan, Yili Bali, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Java, Champa, Ryukyu, Bengal, Hami, Turfan, Yili Bali, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on the day guichou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, at the opening of spring, on guichou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，尚書夏原吉卒。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Minister Xia Yuanji died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Minister Xia Yuanji died.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，罷工部采木。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renchen, the Ministry of Works' timber-gathering was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen, the Ministry of Works was ordered to cease its timber levies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，頒寬恤之令，省災傷，寬馬政，免逋欠薪芻，招流民賜復一年，罷採買，減官田舊科十之三，恤工匠，禁司倉官包納，戒法司慎刑獄。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, an edict of lenient relief was promulgated: disaster losses were reduced, horse administration was eased, overdue hay and fodder payments were forgiven, wandering people were summoned and granted a year's exemption from service, procurement for the palace was halted, the old levy on official fields was cut by three-tenths, artisans were shown favor, officials of the granaries were forbidden to act as brokers in grain, and the judiciary was admonished to be cautious in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he promulgated a broad edict of mercy: disaster districts were relieved, horse corvée was eased, arrears in hay and fodder were canceled, refugees were called home with a year's tax holiday, palace purchases were stopped, the old tax on official fields was cut by three-tenths, artisans were favored, granary clerks were forbidden to act as brokers, and the courts were warned to punish with restraint.

sentences.zh: 乙未，奉皇太后謁陵。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, he accompanied the Empress Dowager to pay homage at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he led the Empress Dowager to the tombs to pay homage.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，道見耕者，下馬問農事，取耒三推，顧侍臣曰：「朕三推巳不勝勞，況吾民終歲勤動乎。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wushen, on the road he saw farmers plowing; he dismounted to ask about farming, took the plough and pushed three furrows, and turning to his attendants said: "I am already exhausted by three pushes—how much more my people, who toil through the whole year."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wushen, he met farmers on the road, dismounted to ask after their work, took the plough and traced three furrows, then told his attendants, "Three passes of the plough have worn me out—think what a year of labor costs our people."

sentences.zh: 」命賜所過農民鈔，己酉，還宮。

translations.literal: He ordered paper money bestowed on the farmers he passed; on the day jiyou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered cash notes given to every farmer along the route; on jiyou he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，李琦還，黎利稱陳氏無後，上表請封。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Li Qi returned; Le Loi said the Chen house had no heirs and submitted a memorial requesting enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Qi came back reporting that Le Loi claimed the Chen line was extinct and asked to be enfeoffed in his stead.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免山西去歲被災田租。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, land rent for last year's disaster in Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen land tax was forgiven for last year's disaster counties in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜林震等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Lin Zhen and other metropolitan graduates were granted jinshi with ranks of Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Lin Zhen and the new jinshi were graduated into the Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate ranks as their marks allowed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，薛祿帥師築赤城、雕鶚、雲州、獨石、團山城堡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wuyin, Xue Lu led troops to build the fortresses of Chicheng, Diaoge, Yunzhou, Dushi, and Tuanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, Xue Lu took the field to raise the fortresses at Chicheng, Diaoge, Yunzhou, Dushi, and Tuanshan.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，追奪贓吏誥敕，著為令。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guimao, patents of office were stripped from corrupt officials and this was written into regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao, patents of rank were clawed back from venal officials and the practice was codified.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，修預備倉，出官錢收糴備荒。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, reserve granaries were repaired and official funds were used to buy grain against famine.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen reserve granaries were restored and state silver was spent to fill them against dearth.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，擢郎中況鐘、御史何文淵九人為知府，賜敕遣之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, nine men including Bureau Director Kuang Zhong and Censor He Wenyuan were promoted to prefect and sent out with imperial commissions.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai nine men, among them Kuang Zhong and He Wenyuan, were raised from the center to prefect and sent to their posts with sealed commissions.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，遣官捕近畿蝗，諭戶部曰：「往年捕蝗之使害民不減於蝗，宜知此弊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jimao, officials were sent to catch locusts in the metropolitan districts; he charged the Ministry of Revenue, saying: "In former years the locust-catching envoys harmed the people no less than the locusts—you should know this abuse."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, officers were sent to hunt locusts near the capital; he warned the Ministry of Revenue, "Years ago the locust commissioners preyed on the people worse than the insects—remember that abuse."

sentences.zh: 」因作《捕蝗詩》示之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he composed the "Poem on Catching Locusts" and showed it to them.
translations.idiomatic: He then wrote the Poem on Catching Locusts and had it circulated among them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，甄別守令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day guihai, prefects and magistrates were graded for merit and fault.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guihai, local administrators were sorted for promotion or censure.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳朔，日食，陰雨不見，禮官請表賀，不許。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jisi, there was a solar eclipse, but rain and cloud hid it; the ritual officials requested a congratulatory memorial, and this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the eighth month an eclipse fell, yet rain and cloud hid it; the ritualists asked to memorialize the omen, and the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，擢御史于謙、長史周忱六人為侍郎，巡撫兩京、山東、山西、河南、江西、浙江、湖廣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingwu, six men including Censor Yu Qian and Chief Steward Zhou Chen were promoted to vice minister and sent as grand coordinators of the two capitals, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, six men—among them Yu Qian and Zhou Chen—were made vice ministers and dispatched as grand coordinators over the two capitals, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，巡近郊。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, he toured the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he toured the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己未，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，阿魯台犯遼東，遼海衛指揮同知皇甫斌力戰死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day yihai, Aruqtai raided Liaodong; Vice Commander Huangfu Bin of Liaohai Guard died fighting with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, Aruqtai struck Liaodong, and Vice Commander Huangfu Bin of Liaohai Guard fell after a desperate stand.

sentences.zh: 丙子，巡近郊。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, he toured the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he again toured the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，獵於坌道。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he hunted at Bendao.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he hunted at Bendao.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至洗馬林，遍閱城堡兵備。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he reached Ximolin and inspected the fortresses and military preparations throughout.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he came to Ximolin and went through every fortress and its stores of arms.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，曲先叛番平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guisi, the rebellious tribes of Quxian were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, the rebel tribes of Quxian were brought to peace.

sentences.zh: 閏月己未，敕內外諸司，久淹獄囚者罪之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiwei, an edict charged all offices within and without that whoever long detained prisoners in jail would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiwei, he ordered every office at court and in the provinces to answer with punishment for any who kept prisoners languishing in jail.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、琉球、爪哇、瓦剌、哈密、罕東、土魯番、撒馬兒罕、亦力把裏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Ryukyu, Java, Oirat, Hami, Handong, Turfan, Samarkand, and Yili Bali sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, Ryukyu, Java, the Oirats, Hami, Handong, Turfan, Samarkand, and Yili Bali.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, the first month, on the day dingchou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at the opening of spring, on dingchou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大雨雷電。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, great rain fell with thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen a storm broke with thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，侍郎羅汝敬督陝西屯田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingyou, Vice Minister Luo Rujing supervised military colonies in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou, Vice Minister Luo Rujing was put in charge of military colonies in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 己亥，浚金龍口，引河達徐州以便漕。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the Golden Dragon Mouth was dredged and the river led through to Xuzhou to ease the grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Golden Dragon Mouth was opened and the river channeled to Xuzhou to ease the grain route.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，命吏部考察外官自布政、按察二司始，著為令。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yihai, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to examine outside officials beginning with the provincial administration and surveillance commissioners, and this was written into regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to begin performance reviews of provincial officials with the administration and surveillance commissioners, and the practice was codified.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，侍郎柴車經理山西屯田。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiyou, Vice Minister Chai Che managed military colonies in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, Vice Minister Chai Che was sent to oversee military colonies in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，遣使詔黎利權署安南國事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jihai, envoys were sent with an edict appointing Le Loi to administer Annam's affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai, envoys were sent to invest Le Loi with provisional rule over Annam.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬午，許朵顏三衛市易。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Three Guards of Doyin were permitted to trade at the markets.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Three Guards of Doyin were allowed to trade at the border markets.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，陳懷平松潘蠻。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiachen, Chen Huai pacified the Songpan tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen, Chen Huai pacified the Songpan tribes.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，始命官軍兌運民糧。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingzi, troops and officials were first ordered to transport the people's grain by redemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, the court first ordered troops and transport officials to move the people's grain under the redemption transport system.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，分遣御史往逮貪暴中官袁琦等。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, censors were separately dispatched to arrest the rapacious eunuch Yuan Qi and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou censors were sent out in separate parties to seize the predatory eunuch Yuan Qi and his confederates.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，袁琦等十一人棄市，榜其罪示天下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiwei, Yuan Qi and eleven others were executed in the marketplace, and their crimes were posted to inform the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei, Yuan Qi and eleven others were beheaded in the marketplace, and a placard of their crimes was sent through the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金幼孜卒。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Jin Youzi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Jin Youzi died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣御史巡視寧夏甘州屯田水利。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, censors were sent to inspect military colonies and waterworks in Ningxia and Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu censors were dispatched to review the military colonies and irrigation works of Ningxia and Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、琉球、瓦剌、哈密、蘇門答剌、亦力把裏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Ryukyu, Oirat, Hami, Samudera, and Yili Bali sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, Ryukyu, the Oirats, Hami, Samudera, and Yili Bali.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛酉朔，日有食之，免朝賀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on the first day xinyou, there was a solar eclipse; court congratulations were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the xinyou new moon of spring, an eclipse darkened the sun and the New Year audience was canceled.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，以春和諭法司錄囚。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiawu, because spring was mild he charged the judiciary to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, with the season turning mild, he ordered the judiciary to review the prisons.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，下詔行寬恤之政。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengshen, an edict was issued to carry out policies of lenient relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, he issued an edict enacting another round of merciful government.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，諭禮部曰：「朕以官田賦重，十減其三。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, he charged the Ministry of Rites, saying: "I reduced the levy on official fields by three-tenths because the burden was heavy."
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he told the Ministry of Rites, "I cut the tax on official fields by three-tenths because the burden had grown unbearable."

sentences.zh: 乃聞異時蠲租詔下，戶部皆不行，甚者戒約有司，不得以詔書為辭。

translations.literal: Yet I hear that whenever rent was remitted in former times, the Ministry of Revenue never carried it out; some even warned the local offices that they must not use the edict as an excuse.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I hear that whenever rent was forgiven in former reigns the Ministry of Revenue never obeyed, and some even warned local officers not to plead the edict.

sentences.zh: 是廢格詔令，使澤不下究也。

translations.literal: This is to set aside and block the edict, so that the benefit does not reach below.
translations.idiomatic: That is to nullify the throne's word and keep the benefit from reaching the people.

sentences.zh: 自今令在必行，毋有所遏。」

translations.literal: From now on, when an order is issued it must be carried out—let there be no obstruction."
translations.idiomatic: From this day forward every command is to be executed without delay—let no one stand in its way."

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，免山西逋賦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinchou, overdue levies in Shanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, arrears of tax in Shanxi were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，募商中鹽輸粟入邊。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, merchants were recruited to deliver grain to the frontier in exchange for salt licenses.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin merchants were invited to carry grain to the border garrisons in return for salt certificates.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guimao, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao, the court reviewed prisoners in custody.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷中官入番市馬。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, eunuchs were barred from entering frontier markets to buy horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou eunuchs were forbidden to enter frontier markets to purchase horses.

sentences.zh: 是月，作《官箴》成，凡三十五篇，示百官。

translations.literal: That month the "Admonitions for Officials" was completed—thirty-five sections in all—and shown to the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Admonitions for Officials was finished, thirty-five sections in all, and displayed to the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙未，敕京官三品以上舉才行文學之士，吏部、都察院黜方面有司不職者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day yiwei, an edict ordered capital officials of third rank and above to recommend men of ability, conduct, and literary learning; the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate dismissed incompetent provincial officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on yiwei, the throne ordered capital officials of third rank and above to recommend men of talent, character, and letters; the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate cashiered incompetent provincial magistrates.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，諸將巡邊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengwu, the generals toured the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, the generals made a frontier inspection tour.

sentences.zh: 是秋，免兩畿及嘉興。

translations.literal: That autumn, tax grain was remitted in the Two Capitals districts and Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn tax grain was remitted in the Two Capitals districts and Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 湖州水災稅糧。

translations.literal: Tax grain for Huzhou's flood disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax grain for Huzhou's flood disaster was remitted as well.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，召督漕平江伯陳瑄、侍郎趙新等歲終至京議糧賦利弊。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day xinyou, Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport Chen Xuan, the Pingjiang Earl, Vice Minister Zhao Xin, and others were summoned to reach the capital by year's end to discuss the advantages and disadvantages of grain levies.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on xinyou, Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport Chen Xuan, Earl of Pingjiang, Vice Minister Zhao Xin, and others were summoned to reach the capital by year's end and debate the merits of grain levies.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、琉球、哈密、哈烈、瓦剌、亦力把裏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Champa, Ryukyu, Hami, Herat, Oirat, and Ili Balik paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Ryukyu, Hami, Herat, Oirat, and Ili Balik sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丁卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighth year, the first month, on the day dingmao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eighth year, the first month, on dingmao, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，錄囚，宥免五千餘人。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renzi, prisoners were reviewed; more than five thousand were pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, prisoners were reviewed and more than five thousand pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，賜曹鼐等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingchen, Cao Nai and other jinshi were granted ranked honors of metropolitan graduate and lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen, Cao Nai and other jinshi received metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，諭內外優恤軍士，違者風憲官察奏罪之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, an edict instructed officials within and without to give preferential care to soldiers; violators would be investigated and charged by surveillance censors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the court ordered officials at court and in the provinces to treat soldiers with generous care; violators would be impeached and punished by surveillance censors.

sentences.zh: 是春，以兩京、河南、山東、山西久旱，遣使振恤。

translations.literal: That spring, because of prolonged drought in the Two Capitals, Henan, Shandong, and Shanxi, envoys were dispatched with relief.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, with drought lingering in the Two Capitals, Henan, Shandong, and Shanxi, envoys were sent with relief grain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，詔蠲京省被災逋和、雜課，免今年夏稅，賜復一年。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuxu, an edict remitted overdue payments and miscellaneous levies in the capital provinces from disaster areas, exempted this year's summer tax, and granted one year of labor-service exemption.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on wuxu, an edict remitted disaster arrears and miscellaneous levies in the metropolitan provinces, exempted the summer tax for the year, and granted one year of corvée exemption.

sentences.zh: 理冤獄。

translations.literal: Unjust cases were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Wrongful convictions were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 減殊死以下，赦軍匠在逃者罪。

translations.literal: Sentences below capital punishment were reduced; deserters among military artisans were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Sentences short of death were reduced, and deserters among military artisans were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 有司各舉賢良方正一人。

translations.literal: Each relevant office recommended one person of worthy and upright character.
translations.idiomatic: Each office recommended one man of worthy and upright character.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史、按察使糾貪酷吏及使臣生事者。

translations.literal: Touring censors and provincial surveillance commissioners impeached greedy and cruel officials and envoys who stirred trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Touring censors and provincial surveillance commissioners impeached greedy and cruel officials and envoys who stirred up trouble.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，總兵官都督蕭授討平貴州烏羅蠻。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, Regional Commander Grand Coordinator Xiao Shou pacified the Wuluo tribes of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi, Regional Commander Xiao Shou pacified the Wuluo tribes of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，山雲討平宜山蠻。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Shan Yun pacified the Yishan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Shan Yun pacified the Yishan tribes.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，禱雨不應，作《閔旱詩》示群臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yiyou, rain prayers went unanswered; he composed "Poems Mourning the Drought" and showed them to his ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, rain prayers brought no answer; he composed Poems Mourning the Drought and showed them to his ministers.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔中外疏決罪囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered prompt disposal of criminal cases at court and in the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict ordered prompt judgment of prisoners at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 是夏，復振兩京、河南、山東、山西、湖廣饑，免稅糧。

translations.literal: That summer, famine relief was again sent to the Two Capitals, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Huguang; tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That summer relief was again sent to the Two Capitals, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Huguang, and tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，免江西水災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renshen, Jiangxi's flood-disaster tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, Jiangxi's flood-disaster tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，汰京師冗官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guisi, redundant officials in the capital were culled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, redundant officials in the capital were culled.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛亥，西域貢麒麟。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day xinhai, the Western Regions presented a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinhai, the Western Regions presented a qilin.

sentences.zh: 戊午，景星見。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the auspicious star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the auspicious star appeared.

sentences.zh: 禮官請表賀，皆不許。

translations.literal: The ritual officials asked to present congratulatory memorials; all were refused.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials asked to present congratulatory memorials; the Emperor refused them all.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，遣官錄天下重囚。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yiyou, officials were dispatched to review serious prisoners throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiyou, officials were sent to review serious prisoners throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己亥，阿魯台部昝卜寇涼州，總兵官劉廣擊斬之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Zanbu of Aruqtai's tribe raided Liangzhou; Regional Commander Liu Guang struck and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zanbu of Aruqtai's tribe raided Liangzhou; Regional Commander Liu Guang struck and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙亥，諭法司宥京官過犯。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, on the day yihai, the judicial offices were instructed to pardon minor offenses of capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the twelfth month, on yihai, the judicial offices were instructed to pardon minor offenses of capital officials.

translations.literal: That year Siam, Champa, Ryukyu, Annam, Malacca, Mecca, Samudra, Calicut, Cochin, Aden, Ceylon, Dhofar, Cambay, Kayal, Hormuz, Hami, Oirat, Samarkand, and Ili Balik paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam, Champa, Ryukyu, Annam, Malacca, Mecca, Samudra, Calicut, Cochin, Aden, Ceylon, Dhofar, Cambay, Kayal, Hormuz, Hami, Oirat, Samarkand, and Ili Balik sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the ninth year, the first month, on the day xinmao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the ninth year, the first month, on xinmao, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，振鳳陽、淮安、揚州、徐州饑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengxu, relief was sent to famine in Fengyang, Huai'an, Yangzhou, and Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu, grain relief was sent to Fengyang, Huai'an, Yangzhou, and Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，申兩京、山東、山西、河南寬恤之令。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the order of generous relief for the Two Capitals, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the order of generous relief for the Two Capitals, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，山雲討症思恩叛蠻。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, Shan Yun campaigned against rebellious tribes of Ping Sien.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, Shan Yun campaigned against the rebellious tribes of Ping Sien.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，黎利死，子麟來告喪，命麟權署安南國事。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiwei, Le Loi died; his son Lin came to announce the mourning; Lin was ordered to act in charge of Annam's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jiwei, Le Loi died; his son Lin came to announce the mourning, and Lin was ordered to act in charge of Annam's affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renwu, exposed corpses were buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu, exposed corpses were buried.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，遣給事中、御史、錦衣衛官督捕兩畿、山東、山西、河南蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiashen, supervising secretaries, censors, and Brocade Guard officers were dispatched to supervise locust eradication in the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiashen, supervising secretaries, censors, and Brocade Guard officers were sent to supervise locust eradication in the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，振湖廣饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, relief was sent to famine in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, grain relief was sent to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕兩京、湖廣、江西、河南巡撫、巡按御史、三司官行視災傷，蠲秋糧十之四。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered grand coordinators, touring censors, and the three commissions of the Two Capitals, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Henan to inspect disaster damage and remit four-tenths of the autumn grain tax.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the throne ordered grand coordinators, touring censors, and the three commissions of the Two Capitals, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Henan to inspect disaster damage and remit four-tenths of the autumn grain tax.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷工部採辦。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, procurement by the Ministry of Works was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou procurement by the Ministry of Works was halted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，瓦剌脫歡攻殺阿魯台，來告捷。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Toghon of Oirat attacked and killed Aruqtai and came to report victory.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Toghon of Oirat attacked and killed Aruqtai and came to report victory.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，自將巡邊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, the Emperor personally led a frontier tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the Emperor led a frontier tour in person.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，度居庸關。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, he passed Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he passed Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，獵於坌道。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he hunted at Bendao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he hunted at Bendao.

sentences.zh: 乙未，阿魯臺子阿卜只俺來貴。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Abuji'an, son of Aruqtai, came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Abuji'an, son of Aruqtai, came to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，至洗馬林，閱城堡兵備。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, he reached Ximolin and inspected fortress troops and defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he reached Ximolin and inspected fortress troops and defenses.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大獵。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, a great hunt was held.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai a great hunt was held.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，還宮。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingwu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on bingwu, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，都督方政討平松潘叛蠻。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Regional Commander Fang Zheng pacified rebellious tribes of Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Regional Commander Fang Zheng pacified the rebellious tribes of Songpan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷陝西市馬。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Shaanxi frontier horse market was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Shaanxi frontier horse market was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，兩畿、浙江、湖廣、江西饑，以應運南京及臨清倉粟振濟。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, famine struck the Two Capitals districts, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi; grain from the Yingyun granaries of Nanjing and the Linqing warehouses was used for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao famine struck the Two Capitals districts, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi; grain from the Yingyun granaries of Nanjing and the Linqing warehouses was used for relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，停刑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuxu, executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免四川被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Sichuan's disaster tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Sichuan's disaster tax grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，帝不豫，衛王瞻埏攝享太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, the Emperor fell ill; Prince of Wei Zhu Zhanshan acted as regent to offer sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, the Emperor fell ill; the Prince of Wei, Zhu Zhanshan, acted as regent to offer sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、占城、琉球、蘇門答剌、哈密、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year Siam, Champa, Ryukyu, Samudra, Hami, and Oirat paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam, Champa, Ryukyu, Samudra, Hami, and Oirat sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月癸酉朔，不視朝，命群臣謁皇太子于文華殿。

translations.literal: In spring of the tenth year, the first month, on the day guiyou, the new year's first day, he did not hold court; the ministers were ordered to pay homage to the Crown Prince in the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year, the first month, on guiyou, the new year's first day, he did not hold court; the ministers were ordered to pay homage to the Crown Prince in the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大漸。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, his illness turned critical.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu his illness turned critical.

sentences.zh: 罷買、營造諸使。

translations.literal: Procurement and construction envoys were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Procurement and construction envoys were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，崩于乾清宮，年三十有八。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he died in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, aged thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he died in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, aged thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 遺詔國家重務白皇太后。

translations.literal: His final testament charged the Empress Dowager with affairs of state weight.
translations.idiomatic: His final testament charged the Empress Dowager with affairs of state weight.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上尊諡，廟號宣宗，葬景陵。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, posthumous titles were raised; his temple name was Xuanzong, and he was buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou posthumous titles were raised; his temple name was Xuanzong, and he was buried at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：仁宗為太子，失愛于成誼。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: "As crown prince, Renzong lost favor with Chengzu."
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says, "As crown prince, Renzong lost favor with Chengzu."

sentences.zh: 其危而復安，太孫蓋有力焉。

translations.literal: He stood in peril yet was restored to safety—the great-grandson heir had much to do with it.
translations.idiomatic: He stood in peril yet was restored to safety—the great-grandson heir had much to do with it.

sentences.zh: 即位以後，吏稱其職，政得其平，綱紀修明，倉庾充羨，閭閻樂業。

translations.literal: After he took the throne, officials fulfilled their duties, government found its balance, discipline was clear, granaries overflowed, and the lanes knew contentment.
translations.idiomatic: After he took the throne, officials fulfilled their duties, government found its balance, discipline was clear, granaries overflowed, and the lanes knew contentment.

sentences.zh: 歲不能災。

translations.literal: No year could bring disaster.
translations.idiomatic: No year could bring disaster.

sentences.zh: 蓋明興至是歷年六十，民氣漸舒，蒸然有治平之象矣。

translations.literal: From the founding of the Ming to this point sixty years had passed; the people's spirits eased, and signs of good order rose like steam.
translations.idiomatic: From the founding of the Ming to this point sixty years had passed; the people's spirits eased, and signs of good order rose like steam.

sentences.zh: 若乃強籓猝起，旋即削平，掃蕩邊塵，狡寇震懾，帝之英姿睿略，庶幾克繩祖武者歟。

translations.literal: When powerful fiefs suddenly rose, they were swiftly cut down; border dust was swept away and crafty foes were awed—the Emperor's heroic bearing and keen strategy perhaps matched the martial prowess of his ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: When powerful fiefs suddenly rose, they were swiftly cut down; border dust was swept away and crafty foes were awed—the Emperor's heroic bearing and keen strategy perhaps matched the martial prowess of his ancestors.
